title: Visit to Allen Dulles's former office in Switzerland

tellings.quote: He told us when he got permission to maintain a very active office here that as long as he was in Switzerland, no American law could reach him

plain: On a visit to the old office in Switzerland of Allen Dulles, the American spymaster who later ran the CIA, Swiss officials are said to have told visitors that Dulles had boasted that as long as he was in Switzerland, "no American law could reach him." The former presidential advisor Harald Malmgren tells this, repeating what the Swiss officials told his group. It is told to suggest Dulles worked beyond the reach of his own government.
